blocks.html:
Mercedes Sprinter 2500 Vehicle Decals

We say “Get your business on wheels with promotional vehicle decals” but this client literally has his business on wheels, all the more reason to get decals. This is about the time we heard from this client who has a mobile hair grooming business.

The person who owns the business is actually from the US but he sent his Mercedes Sprinter 2500 to Toronto to get the inside fitted out with all the essential equipment needed to cut hair. We spoke with this client’s outfitter/middleman in the initial few months of 2020. At the time, he was looking to get some other work done for the Mercedes Sprinter 2500.

A few months later, he decided to get promotional vehicle decals on the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 to advertise the mobile business. Since he remembered having a chat with us, he thought to reach out to us again about a quote to get some vehicle decals.

After receiving a satisfactory quote from us, he brought in these pictures of the vehicle with dimensions as to where the vehicle decals are supposed to be. The problem here was that the pictures were of a different vehicle than the one he brought into our garage. This is a common misunderstanding for our clients. In order to perform our job with perfection, our installers need the accurate dimensions and positioning of decals. Since the dimensions he brought in were of a different vehicle, our installers and designers worked to get them right for the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 that the client brought in.

The installation process was fairly simple as it is in the case of most decal jobs. The decals show the logo for the mobile business on several locations and in a variety of sizes on the vehicle along with his Instagram username. We used “Gloss Metalic Gold” from Avery Dennison’s SW900 series for these decals. The black colour of the Mercedes Sprinter 2500 really makes the golden decals pop. The client left the garage happily just like the rest of our happy customers.

Expert Advice by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s Installers

Having been working in the industry for more than a decade, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have a few tips on where to get the decals on your vehicle. Similar to what we supplied to this client:

1. The Sides:

Sides are the biggest canvas on any vehicle if you’re looking to let your imagination out. Vehicle Decals installed on sides are easily visible and real estate gives you the ability to be creative. Get a couple of decals on either side and you’re good to go. Side decals are clearly visible to people driving parallel to you on the road.

2. The Hood:

Decals on the hood are effective for when you’re vehicle is parked somewhere. People walking past your vehicle can’t help but notice this giant sticker right on the hood of your car.

3. The Back:

The Lettering & Decals on the back are visible to people driving behind your vehicle. So get creative and put your business logo on the back for people to look at.

4. The Roof:

Not a lot of people go for Vehicle decals on the roof since they believe they aren’t visible to people. However, experts at Vinyl Wrap Toronto would agree to disagree with that. With buildings with several floors and people looking out their windows, you can either show them a well-crafted ad or a plain old roof. The choice is yours.

Do you have a business that could use effective marketing? Contact our team today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 for information about vehicle graphics.
